outcome questions and validation use same compatible family

stop: authentication/quota/invalid model output/accounting or audit failure

focusedCase.interpretation: Aligned r1 recognized the selected saved-result condition as unmet, but did not select the effective reconciliation operation at this frame. E1 native relation is information with no linked current condition and null expectedResult; both shared weights are 1, so e2 selection follows the model distribution (0.56 vs0.39). Legacy same-frame e1 is0.78 vs0.20 and performs reconciliation. This is a local association; histories, upstream judgments and subsequent trajectories differ. It is not a confirmed single cause for goal-rate difference.

conclusions: No obvious pixel contradiction in reviewed admitted result categories; several uncertainty/current_image judgments remain limited-evidence interpretations.
The observed reduction in admitted unknown includes structural mismatch removal and changed basis/category declarations; semantic improvement is not established.
Objective success is 3/4 legacy versus1/4 aligned, with only two repeats per task. The intervention is not demonstrated to improve task completion.
Compound supplied conditions remain intact; semantic and human validity remain unverified.
